# Agent N's Hermes News — 2026-10-14

**Executive summary:** The version train jumped tracks. After days of **v0.21.7** RC churn that never produced a stable tag in coverage, the **v0.22.0** pre-release cycle opened fast — [**rc.1**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=news#item-f643d3e359ad) tagged and immediately followed by [**rc.2**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=news#item-33523d345566) on 2026-10-13, making **rc.2** the build to test ahead of stable. Social reinforces imminent shipping: **@Teknium** teased [new update channels](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-79dfc44d94ec) (~15k views), confirmed [beta testers are being actively recruited](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-e4a1d393e0ab), and replies pointed to [an imminent merge going live "with release soon."](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-e304d857eb75) The cycle's other headline is ecosystem growth — a paid crypto/market-data skill ([**AlphaPipeline**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=news#item-9686cf959e04) via **x402** on **Base**), a [mysterious unnamed plugin tease](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-549ab41ac6ed) driving outsized curiosity, and **@rlaope**'s [**oh-my-hermes**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-80eb5732478d) barreling toward [**4.0.0**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-63cd755c3b21) with roughly **200B tokens** of testing behind it and a [**3.4k-star**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-83f56ce06aef) milestone. The batch's top post is a company milestone rather than a feature: the [**Hermes Agent mobile app** kickoff](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-526772b007ca) and a welcome to new hire **Florian**. Security remains the standing watch item (carried [adversarial repo](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49231797), carried [trance-state thread](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49916751)), and the clock that matters most still reads **2026-10-15** — memory-provider migrations are due.

## Releases

The **v0.22.0** cycle for hermes-agent kicked off on 2026-10-13: **rc.1** was tagged and immediately followed by **rc.2** the same day in the [news feed](/?date=2026-10-13&category=news), making **rc.2** the pre-release to test ahead of stable. If you track upcoming features, update your checkout now.

Context for the version picture: the **v0.21.7** sprint (**rc.5**–**rc.15**, 2026-10-10 → 2026-10-12) never landed a stable tag in coverage, and **v0.21.6** remains the last confirmed stable — so read the jump to **v0.22.0** as one continuous build signal, not a reset. The [research feed](/?date=2026-10-13&category=research) also re-featured **Hermes Agent v0.20.0** (GitHub tag **v2026.8.3**) — that's official-docs catch-up on a long-carried release, not a fresh launch.

Shipping momentum from [social](/?date=2026-10-13&category=social): new **update channels** teased (433 likes, ~15k views), **beta testers** actively recruited, and a merge flagged as going live imminently "with release soon."

## Community

Plugin and skill ecosystem growth is the dominant cross-cutting story this cycle:

- **AlphaPipeline** — a new skill registry entry bringing paid, per-call crypto and market/token-risk data to Hermes via an **x402 API** on **Base** (**MCP**-accessible). A clean showcase of monetized third-party skills arriving in the catalog.
- Catalog curiosity ran hot: a **mysterious unnamed plugin** appeared (12.3k views, 196 likes), while an [**official third-party Hermes Agent plugin**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-d299e24bd67e) drew the batch's biggest reach (22k+ views, 433 likes).
- **@rlaope**'s **oh-my-hermes** is the standout community project: a substantive showcase of its [orchestration layer](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-80eb5732478d) — skill catalog, self-maintaining long-term memory, model routing — with [**oh-my-hermes 4.0.0** in preparation (~**200B tokens** burned in testing)](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-63cd755c3b21), a [**3.4k-star** GitHub milestone](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-83f56ce06aef), and a [dedicated Discord](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-16bcfcfd5d1f). Third-party layers are maturing into products in their own right. **@rlaope** also shared [**jeval**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-c15f223633fb), a well-received evaluation dashboard skill for calibrating classifier confidence thresholds.
- Team and visibility: the top post of the batch was **@Teknium**'s [**Hermes Agent mobile app** kickoff, welcoming new hire **Florian**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-526772b007ca). CEO **Dillon Rolnick** [presented at the AI Engineering Conference in NYC](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-18fed1058790) (photo by **altryne**), and Nous Research [confirmed it is **still hiring**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-8943be9ff97a).
- Builder economics: **@rlaope** [amplified **90% discounts**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-3d06c5b73cc5) on **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Ultrafast** (deal live — consistent with **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash**, GA 2026-09-10) and upcoming **GLM-5.3-Flash-Ultrafast** via OpenRouter, pitched as "Fable-class work at 1/30" cost. Standing caution: the **GLM-5.3** reference remains unverified against the confirmed Z.ai catalog, which tops out at **GLM-5.2** (2026-06-16) — quote pricing as announced.
- Research radar: the feed's top story was [**X-Ragent**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-2610.16811), a tool-augmented RL framework for evidence-grounded chest X-ray reasoning — adjacent to Hermes, but methodologically relevant to agent tool use.

Carried, not new: the [adversarial **hermes-jekyl-hyde** "LLM reversal" repository](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49231797) targeting hermes-agent and the [Ask HN thread about a freshly provisioned agent spiraling into a trance-like state](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49916751) on a headless server remain the security/reliability warnings for anyone running agents unattended or in production. The [~**23,000 open pull requests** backlog](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49424643) on the core repo is still the project-health number to watch — community scale with maintainer bottlenecks. Community staples like [**Refine Cycle**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49606988) and the [**Codex**↔**Claude Code** issue-to-PR skill](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49136162) round out the carried set.

**Deadline reminder:** three memory providers leave Hermes Agent core on **2026-10-15** — the next news cycle. Migrate external backends (e.g., **Honcho**) now if you haven't; built-in **MEMORY.md**/**USER.md** remains the default.

## Tips & Tutorials

- While the RC train runs, **@Teknium**'s [guidance is to stay on the **main channel**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=social#item-8e25e24ab379) for minute-by-minute updates — and if you want to shape the stable, beta-tester recruitment is open now. This is the window to test **v0.22.0-rc.2** against your workflows.
- **jeval** is worth a look if you run classifiers in your skills: it's built for calibrating confidence thresholds with a dashboard view.
- Carried self-hosting map (first flagged 2026-10-11, still the practical guidance for always-on deployments): the [**Kubernetes** walkthrough](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49977400) flags the missing official **Helm** chart and the container image's **root-at-init** requirement; the [**grafana-agento11y-hermes** project](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49318128) closes the monitoring gap; and the [**Arduino UNO Q** board](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49368474) remains a compact, capable agent host.

---

**Housekeeping:** the [automated daily repo sync](/?date=2026-10-14&category=news#item-80b4ab58d33e) landed with no user-facing changes (safe to ignore); no merged PRs cleared the bar; Reddit contributed nothing again.

**Net read:** no stable tag yet, but the version story moved — a same-day **rc.1**/**rc.2** double-tap plus update-channel teases and beta recruitment say **v0.22.0** stable is close. The strategic picture continues to sharpen around extensibility: paid skills, catalog buzz, and **oh-my-hermes** maturing into a product, all while the mobile-app kickoff signals expanding company investment. Practical agenda for the next 24 hours: test **rc.2**, and finish those memory-provider migrations before **2026-10-15**.

research.category_summary: Official project momentum led the cycle. **[Hermes Agent v0.20.0](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49159200)** (GitHub tag **v2026.8.3**) shipped as the latest versioned release, a new SDK plugin adds **[Claude Pro/Max subscription](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49790991)** support to the agent — a major cost/access win for existing subscribers — and **[Hermes Kanban](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49604068)** documentation details built-in multi-agent orchestration via agent profiles on a shared board. Self-hosters get two practical upgrades: a [Kubernetes walkthrough flagging the missing official **Helm chart**](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49977400) and the container image's root-at-init requirement, plus a **[Grafana](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49318128)** observability project closing the monitoring gap for agent deployments. Integration coverage matured with **[LanceDB](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49133145)**'s guide to persistent semantic memory and a community skill automating an issue-to-PR loop between **[Codex](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49136162)** and **Claude Code**; the free open-source **[verso](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49628094)** orchestrator further extends the ecosystem for knowledge work. Project health bears watching: roughly **[23,000 open pull requests](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-hn-49424643)** on the core repo signal both community scale and maintainer bottlenecks. Academic coverage rounds out with **[X-Ragent](/?date=2026-10-14&category=research#item-2610.16811)**, a tool-augmented RL framework for evidence-grounded X-ray reasoning — adjacent to Hermes but methodologically relevant to agent tool use.

top_items.content: Chest X-ray (CXR) interpretation often requires integrating visual findings with task-specific evidence rather than relying on direct visual recognition alone. While tool-augmented medical agents can supply such evidence via external modules, they often lack explicit mechanisms for learning when auxiliary evidence is needed and for preventing inapplicable quantitative evidence from entering diagnostic reasoning. To address this, we propose X-Ragent, a post-training framework for tool-augmented r
top_items.author: HF Daily Papers
top_items.summary: An arXiv paper introducing X-Ragent, a post-training framework for tool-augmented medical agents interpreting chest X-rays. It uses reinforcement learning to teach agents when to fetch auxiliary evidence and to prevent inapplicable quantitative evidence from contaminating diagnostic reasoning, addressing a gap where tool-augmented agents rely on evidence without learning when it is needed.

oh-my-hermes is an orchestration layer for Hermes Agent. 

You install it next to Hermes and it adds a skill catalog, long-term memory that maintains itself, and a router that sends every subagent task to the right model. Hermes itself is never patched.

My current routing setup:
🔭 ultrabrain → GPT-6 Astra
🧠 deep → Claude Opus 5.5 → GPT-6.1 Sol
🏛 architect → Claude Opus 5.5 → GPT-6 Astra
🛠 unspecified-high → GPT-6.1 Sol → Claude Opus 5.5
💸 unspecified-low → GLM 5.3 → DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
⚡ quick → GLM 5.3 Flash → GPT-6 Luna
✍️ writing → Claude Opus 5.5 → Claude Sonnet 5.5
🎨 visual-engineering → Claude Opus 5.5 → Claude Fable 5.1
🌀 artistry → Gemini 3.1 Pro → Claude Opus 5.5
💪 capable → Claude Opus 5.5 → GPT-6.1 Sol
🧩 simple-work → GPT-6 Luna → Claude Haiku 5.5
🏃 deep-work → Claude Opus 5.5 (max)

If one provider is down, it falls through to the next model in the chain. Every chain is editable per machine.

top_items.title:
jev evaluation dashboard skills

Your classifier answers with a label and a confidence. Two question...
top_items.content:
jev evaluation dashboard skills

Your classifier answers with a label and a confidence. Two questions follow, and jeval answers both:

When it says 0.9, how often is it actually right?
Given what a mistake costs, where should the line sit between "the machine decides" and "a human decides"?
The answers come out as one HTML file you can open offline and one YAML file your app reads. Everything is measured from labeled decision records on disk: no server, no database, no network call, no account and no token.

jeval works with anything that returns a probability: a hosted API, a gateway, a local model, a logistic regression, a scoring rule. The name comes from one model family, but the tool sits above all of them.

> https://t.co/ycFYZ5bLD0

#jev
